rulings.1_modifiers: A reaction modifier (or enzymes-list entry) with role activator/inhibitor is never an enzyme. It becomes an Activation/Inhibition interaction in IR bucket processes.modifier_interactions (processes.interactions stays one row per payload interaction, which app.reaction_evidence lines up by count). Left = the modifier resolved as before (role 'enzyme', wrapper complex first). Right = the step's first other enzyme, else (review F4) its first non-currency substrate, then non-currency product, then a currency compound only when the step has nothing else (step_anchor recorded); none -> withheld step_has_no_element_to_anchor. Row carries origin=reaction_modifier, modifier_role, on_reaction {key,name,pointer}, step_anchor, evidence. CORRECTION (review F6): the modifier -> reaction link is kept in pwml_ir.json (processes.modifier_interactions, on_reaction) and in the IR report (interaction_review_required / interaction_withheld_from_pwml issues carry the /processes/reactions/<i>/modifiers/<j> pointer); the text record (app.reaction_evidence) does NOT show it -- it lists payload interactions only. Evidence check: quote must name the modifier and something of the step (enzyme, participant or step name), else review_required (flag only). idx 9 MenD: CORRECTION (review F5): drawn as MenD complex -| MenB complex (the step's enzyme), review_required evidence_does_not_name_step (paper supports DHNA inhibiting MenD; not contradicted -> flagged, not dropped). idx 7: GluTR (glutamyl-tRNA reductase), FC1 complex now Activation interactions on 'singlet oxygen generation from Pchlide' (no enzyme -> anchored on Pchlide), GUN4 complex Activation -> Mg-chelatase step; GUN4 stays an enzyme there only because the payload's own enzymes list names it a catalyst (the duplicate activator-role enzyme entry is gone).
rulings.2_vanishing_signed: Cause 1 (dominant, not a code bug today): the 97 stored payloads predate the ORCH-754b Stage-6 interaction wrapper; replay starts from final_mapped.json so Stage 6 never ran for them. Probe (L4logs/probe_stage6_base.json): today's Stage 6 wraps all 38 bare signed rows (incl. 58/78 2,3-DHB -| EntB, 128 CysK -> CymR). Cause 2 (code, fixed in ir.py): an endpoint that is the exact name of a protein complex AND a synonym of a protein resolved to the bare protein (interaction resolver prefers protein) -> idx 6 'Celsr1 activates Dvl' x2 withheld; now the exact-name complex is used (never an alias, nothing built; ambiguity check stays fail-closed). Cause 3 (code, fixed in Stage 6): a one-protein generated wrapper whose single component carries another name of the same protein (same UniProt) was refused as 'another complex' -> idx 7 FLU/GluTR1 (GluTR1 complex holds HEMA1, P42804); now reused.
rulings.3_new_types: pwml_export_interaction_type exact-match table per brief (binding/binds/binds to/binds_to/noncovalently_bound_to -> Binding; regulates/regulation/modulates -> Regulation; catalyzes -> Catalysis; modifies -> Modification; interaction/interacts with/interacts_with/interacts/associates with/competes_with -> Unspecified). Both edges' template: Activation 149, Inhibition 148, Binding 195, Unspecified 195, Regulation 219, Catalysis 5, Modification 218. Right-edge decoration per PathWhiz t2pw/05 editor: Inhibition flat; Activation/Regulation/Catalysis/Modification start arrow; Binding/Unspecified none. Stage-6 wrapper now wraps protein endpoints of every exportable type. Same element both sides -> withheld same_element_both_sides. Same type + same two elements + same biological state -> written once (withheld duplicate_interaction, duplicate_of key); a repeat in ANOTHER state is written because PathWhiz maps the repeat onto the existing interaction but keeps its visualization (pwml_parser store_nested_object find_existing), and dropping it would lose that compartment's drawing. qa.py accepts the seven types.
rulings.4_evidence: Every IR interaction (payload and modifier rows, drawn or withheld) carries 'evidence'; empty -> review_required ['no_evidence'] + warning interaction_review_required; never dropped. PWML itself has no evidence field on interactions (PathWhiz interactions table has none); evidence lives in pwml_ir.json, the withheld side file, the text record and our SBML.
rulings.orchestrator_3_unstated_relationship: A payload interaction with no interaction_type/relationship/class (interaction_types.relationship_stated) reads as 'interaction' -> Unspecified. With paper evidence: drawn, review_required ['relationship_type_not_stated']. Without evidence: withheld, reason relationship_type_not_stated (in the withheld side file), review_required ['no_evidence']; Stage 6 does not wrap its endpoints. Test: test_pwml_l4_interactions::test_a_row_with_no_relationship_word_is_drawn_unspecified_only_with_evidence. No such row occurs in the 97 replays.
